description: Get the fix for one failed check (check_id from get_visibility_report) on the business's latest linked website report. Returns route (siteme_edit, siteme_builds, in_onhand or paste), the advice, the piece to paste and where it goes (placement) when one fits, an AI-written fix when one is ready, and next, the step to take. On a SiteMe website on Pro, route siteme_edit also stages a SiteMe website edit written only from the listing's approved details and returns it as website_edit (intent, expires_at, consequence); confirm_website_edit applies it after the owner approves the exact consequence. Fixes are on Live and Pro; on Listed it returns plan_required. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: prepare_visibility_fix
title: Prepare a website fix
